QuestInfo.name: Honor of Aran
QuestInfo.0: #p1201000# of the Rien Clan has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: #p1201000# wants Aran to join in the new Battle Mode. Perhaps fighting worthy opponents will bring your memory back. Why don't you try it out?
QuestInfo.2: #p1201000# was happy you reached Rank 9. Given how happy she was, it's not a bad idea to try and earn a few more ranks.

0.0: Hello, Aran. I know your busy, but I've heard a rumor from the penguins that you might be interested in. Something called #bBattle Mode#k has begun in Maple World.
0.1: Battle Mode is a gathering of Maple World's strongest warriors, where they challenge each other to learn who's the best. Maybe testing yourself like this will help you regain some of your memories?
0.2: More than anything, I want you to show the world you're back. Many have forgotten you, but you are the hero of Maple World. Why don't you join in and show the world who you really are?

yes.0: They say you earn a rank when you fight in Battle Mode. I hear that #bRank 9#k is a good goal when you're just starting out. If you had your memory, Rank 1 would be easy for you, but for now...9 is a good first step.
yes.1: To participate in Battle Mode, they say that you must speak to someone named #b#p9070004# on Victoria Island#k. Aran, please go forth and show the world your true strength.

no.0: Of course, fame isn't really the point... But it can't be nice sometimes, right?

1.0: You reached Battle Mode Rank 9! I knew you could do it! To be honest, it would have been embarrassing if you hadn't. You are a hero, after all.

yes.0: I can't wait to see what you accomplish!

default.0: You haven't reached #bRank 9#k in Battle Mode yet? There's no need to hurry, but please keep doing your best. Go see #b#p9070004# in any town#k when you're ready to begin.
